summary: Doubles + light-theme regression validated on Expo web preview (375x800). All 10 primary scenarios pass EXCEPT reset flow: 4-field Doubles setup, team labels ('Alice & Charlie' / 'Bob & Dana'), ICF seat placement (N=Alice, E=Bob, S=Charlie, W=Dana; partners diagonal), scoreboard shows full team labels not clipped (numberOfLines=2 wraps 'Alexander & Christopher' at h=30px, 'Bartholomew & Danielle' at h=32px), seat rotation after full set (Set 1 -> Set 2 rotates [N,E,S,W]->[W,N,E,S]: verified N=Dana, E=Alice, S=Bob, W=Charlie). Singles regression still shows exactly 2 fields (input-Player 1 · North / input-Player 2 · South). Light-theme typed text is correctly dark rgb(15,23,42)=#0F172A on white bg. Sound toggle, theme toggle, Series settings, and Rules bottom sheet all render correctly in both themes. Unlimited header 'BOARD 01 · UNLIMITED' regression from prior iteration remains intact. ONE BUG FOUND: new-match-button (reset) is a no-op on web — Alert.alert callbacks are not invoked in react-native-web so the destructive 'New match' onPress never fires; user stays on Active screen and inputs are not cleared.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping new-match-button on web does nothing. RN Alert.alert renders no dialog on react-native-web (no window.confirm, no in-DOM modal). The destructive button's onPress that calls AsyncStorage.removeItem, setMatch(defaultMatch), setMode('setup'), and clears setA/setB/setA2/setB2 is never invoked. Repro: start match -> tap refresh (new-match-button) -> screen unchanged, no dialog, complete-board still visible. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:64

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Alert.alert with buttons is unreliable on react-native-web — button onPress callbacks never fire. Replace with a cross-platform confirm: e.g. `Platform.OS === 'web' ? window.confirm(...) && onConfirm() : Alert.alert(...)`, or use a Modal-based confirmation sheet. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:64

action_items: Fix new-match-button reset: replace Alert.alert with a Platform-branched confirm — on web use window.confirm('Start a new match? The current board history will be cleared.') and, if true, run the same destructive callback; on native keep Alert.alert. Alternatively, render a small in-app confirmation Modal so behavior is consistent across platforms.

After the fix, re-verify: (a) starting a match then tapping new-match-button returns user to Setup screen with all 4 doubles fields (and both singles fields) cleared, (b) AsyncStorage 'carrom-match' key removed, (c) setMatch reset to defaultMatch.

rca_of_issue: Reset bug RCA: `reset()` in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:64 calls Alert.alert with a destructive-styled button whose onPress performs the actual reset. React Native for Web ships an Alert polyfill that has historically been either a no-op or a `window.alert(title)` call, and never invokes the array of button callbacks. Consequence: on the Expo web preview the app is essentially stuck once a match is started — the user cannot start a new match without manually clearing localStorage. Mitigation: branch on Platform.OS: on 'web' use `if (window.confirm('Start a new match? ...')) { /* same body */ }`; on native keep Alert.alert. Or render a cross-platform confirmation Modal (there is already a Modal for series-settings/rules — reuse the pattern with a 'Cancel'/'New match' button pair).
